Rate uses principal/(principal+idle), kink80%,annual4/20/60%. Current index=storedIndex+floor(storedIndex*rate*elapsed/(1e18*31536000)); debt converts scaled units with ceil. Seized wsNET remains asset custody, not sold cash; insolvency is not repaired by reporting custody as USDG.

Dated withdrawals join cohort/index accounting, funded pro rata as idle arrives, reserved separately from unfunded owed; lend denied while unfunded owed>0. claim(account) pays only account and clips cash. buyHeldWs is ADMIN-only and excludes insuranceWs, despite unrestricted-looking frontend action.

No extra fee just because both endpoints pools. Sender/receiver zero rejected; allowance infinite sentinel supported.

setPool(address,bool)0x20bec12c requires fixed Safe,nonzero target and cannot toggle canonical pair; other pools can be flagged/unflagged immediately. No arbitrary user exemption setter identified; distributor/token-sender exceptions are hardcoded.

Explicit conversion requires nonzero levy amount<=own balance and<=swapThreshold, adequate canonical USDG reserve,live stored TWAP quote and user minimum at least quoted slippage floor; router sends USDG to fixed Sleeve. Automatic conversion only on non-pool-origin transfer,not already inSwap,levy balance>threshold; caps chunk to threshold, skips low reserve/unavailable quote and catches router failure.
